messages:
ryan: Following the 3/15 postmortem, we still have a bunch of open remediation items tied to the eviction/regression pattern. Need clear owners, deadlines, and a runbook lint step so future PRs can't remove triage checks. Volunteers?
eva: I can take the runbook edits + add exact triage commands. I'll include a short regression test that can run in CI.
tom-oncall: I'll own escalation (who pages who) and the oncall checklist. There was confusion about when to escalate to infra vs platform during the incident.
reminder-bot: Created ticket INF-5010: "Runbook edits + CI lint for triage checks" assigned to eva. Due 2025-04-10.
ryan: For runbook triage include: quick health checks, eviction signal queries, and the minimal kill/rollback decision tree. Also add a checkbox for customer-visible impact assessment.
eva: Planned commands to include:
```sh
# nodes under pressure
kubectl top nodes --no-headers | sort -k3 -nr | head -5
# list pods with recent evictions
kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector reason=Evicted -o json | jq '.items[] | {namespace:.metadata.namespace, pod:.involvedObject.name, message:.message}'
# prometheus query for eviction rate by pool
curl -s "${PROMETHEUS}/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)"
```
mia: I'll review the runbook for customer-facing items and prepare a template comms blurb if needed. Can we also add an "owner reminder" step so open remediation items auto-ping after 7 days?
reminder-bot: Created INF-5011: "Owner reminder workflow" scheduled to ping owners at 7 and 14 days.
tom-oncall: Escalation plan I propose:
- step 0: oncall performs triage checklist (<10m)
- step 1: if eviction rate > X for >5m, page infra oncall
- step 2: if >30% capacity loss or customer impact >1 region, escalate to platform lead and product ops
I'll add a small RACI table into the playbook.
ops: Suggest adding a regression harness: run a short synthetic workload that exercises long-lived KV cache access patterns, run nightly. If failure, auto-open INF-5012 with debug logs.
eva: I'll add CI check called `runbook-lint` that ensures PRs touching runbooks include the triage checklist. Example GH action: `if files_changed contains runbooks/** then require runbook-lint`
ryan: Owner recap: eva -> runbook PR + CI lint (due 2025-04-10), tom-oncall -> escalation + RACI (due 2025-04-08), mia -> comms template review (due 2025-04-07), ops -> regression harness spec (due 2025-04-14). reminder-bot -> reminder tickets created.
mia: I'll flag any items that need customer-facing updates by EOD tomorrow.
reminder-bot: Linked INF-5010 -> INF-5011, INF-5012 and set follow-up reminder on 2025-04-17.
ryan: Let's schedule a 2-week verification meeting (15m) to run the drill and confirm the harness and lint are doing their job. I'll send invite. Thanks all.
